components.name: Reserve Button
components.description: The default light reservation action used over dark architectural scenes.
components.css: .ds-reserve-button { min-height: 2.9rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 100vmax; background: var(--bone); color: var(--charcoal); padding: .75rem 1.2rem .7rem 1.35rem; font: 600 .76rem 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; cursor: pointer; transition: color .35s var(--ease), background .35s var(--ease), box-shadow .35s var(--ease); } .ds-reserve-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform .35s var(--ease); } .ds-reserve-button:hover { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgb(17 19 18 / .22); } .ds-reserve-button:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-reserve-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Oxblood Reserve Button
components.description: The warm reservation action used on bone invitation and dialog surfaces.
components.css: .ds-reserve-oxblood { min-height: 3.2rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 100vmax; background: var(--oxblood); color: var(--bone); padding: .8rem 1.35rem; font: 600 .72rem 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .11em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-reserve-oxblood svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-reserve-oxblood:hover { background: var(--charcoal); } .ds-reserve-oxblood:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Mobile Reservation Bar
components.description: The full-width safe-area-aware action that replaces header controls below 900px.
components.css: .ds-mobile-reserve { width: min(100%, 28rem); min-height: 3.2rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border: 0; border-radius: 100vmax; background: var(--amber); color: var(--charcoal); padding: .85rem 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / .3); font: 600 .78rem 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mobile-reserve svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-mobile-reserve:hover { background: var(--bone); } .ds-mobile-reserve:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Reservation Field
components.description: A square, transparent form field with a mono service label and reinforced oxblood focus rule.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: #5a5149; font: 500 .65rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #8b7e70; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--charcoal); padding: .8rem .15rem; font: 400 1rem 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--oxblood); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--oxblood); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Menu Arrow Control
components.description: The compact circular previous/next control exposed with the native mobile dish rail.
components.css: .ds-menu-control { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border: 1px solid rgb(232 224 209 / .45); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--bone); cursor: pointer; font: 400 1rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-menu-control:hover { border-color: var(--amber); color: var(--amber); } .ds-menu-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact uppercase service links with a directional underline reveal.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; color: var(--bone); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font: 500 .75rem 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -.35rem; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform .35s var(--ease); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Craft Sequence Caption
components.description: A translucent, ruled mono annotation floating over the full-viewport craft triptych.
components.css: .ds-craft-caption { width: max-content; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; padding: .8rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgb(232 224 209 / .45); background: rgb(17 19 18 / .35); color: var(--bone); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); font: 500 .68rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-craft-caption i { width: 2.2rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: .5; } .ds-craft-caption:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
SAVRA is a passage from cool architectural restraint into a warm dining ritual. Petrol and charcoal establish the night; amber, oxblood, bone linen, and supplied restaurant imagery reveal fire, table, and craft. The interface refuses a standard restaurant hero followed by interchangeable cards: its recurring grammar is the portal, the staged reveal, and the full-viewport room.

The system is editorial rather than ornamental. Monumental serif language carries atmosphere, condensed service typography carries action and explanation, and mono labels behave like quiet annotations. Controls stay compact and legible at the perimeter while imagery owns the center.
keyCharacteristics: Cool petrol thresholds with a warm amber center.
Full-bleed supplied photography, hard portal masks, and restrained material overlays.
Monumental serif headlines paired with narrow service copy and mono annotations.
Flat architectural surfaces, with lift reserved for floating actions and the modal layer.
Desktop cinematic sequencing that becomes native, touch-first scrolling below 900px.

rules.name: The Temperature Crossing Rule
rules.body: A sequence begins cool and architectural, then earns amber or oxblood warmth at a moment of craft, food, or invitation.

rules.name: The Rare Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is a focal signal, not a general fill; it marks names, emphasis, focus, selection, and the persistent mobile action.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Serif creates desire, condensed sans explains or acts, and mono records; do not swap those jobs casually.

rules.name: The Short-Line Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric headlines are composed as two or three deliberate lines, not allowed to collapse into long prose measures.

rules.name: The Native Mobile Rule
rules.body: Below 900px, prefer touch scrolling, scroll snap, and a persistent action over desktop pinning or horizontal scroll choreography.

rules.name: The Portal Sequence Rule
rules.body: Major sections should feel crossed or entered through framing, clipping, overlap, or a foreground edge; generic centered-card stacks do not belong in this world.

rules.name: The Flat Architecture Rule
rules.body: Use borders, tonal fields, crop, and overlap for structure; reserve shadow for an action that floats or a layer that must interrupt the page.

rules.name: The Soft Action, Hard Field Rule
rules.body: Calls to reserve are pill-shaped; reading surfaces and data-entry fields stay square.

dos: Do begin major narrative passages in petrol or charcoal and earn amber or oxblood warmth through content.
Do keep the supplied room, craft, food, linen, and entrance imagery as the source of atmosphere.
Do use monumental serif type for a few decisive statements and compact mono/narrow type for service information.
Do preserve the behavioral handoff at 899px: desktop choreography becomes native mobile scroll and snap.
Do retain visible focus, the skip link, semantic labels, useful alternatives, and the native dialog behavior.
Do keep every unknown venue or booking detail explicitly marked as forthcoming, prototype, or to be connected.
donts: Don't turn the page into a generic hero followed by a uniform grid of rounded restaurant cards.
Don't use amber as a broad background or distribute all palette colors with equal weight.
Don't add rounded containers, ornamental shadows, or glass surfaces beyond the documented action and modal layers.
Don't carry desktop pinning, magnetic movement, or staged clip-path reveals into touch or reduced-motion paths.
Don't invent menu pricing, service schedules, address, contact, testimonials, press, or reservation confirmation.
Don't treat fallback fonts, prototype submission, or non-responsive media as production-complete.
